home.introTitle: MORECO | Agronomic innovation in the service of regenerative agriculture
introText: For more than 14 years, MORECO has worked closely with the pioneers and developers of stabilised orthosilicic acid (OSA).
Building on this expertise, we support agricultural professionals in Europe, Asia, the United States and, since 2012, in Morocco and the MENA region.
We exclusively select advanced technologies that are internationally recognised for their innovation, effectiveness and reliability.
Our objective is clear: to offer growers agronomic solutions that lastingly improve crop performance, input efficiency and produce quality.
Our exclusive technologies are built on five essential pillars of plant and agronomic performance:

introPoints.title: Optimising nutrient efficiency
introPoints.text: Promoting the uptake, assimilation and efficient use of nutrients to support balanced crop development and yield potential.

introPoints.title: Strengthening plant resilience
introPoints.text: Supporting the plant’s natural defence mechanisms and its ability to adapt to diseases, pests and abiotic stresses such as drought, heat and salinity.

introPoints.title: Optimising water management
introPoints.text: Improving water-use efficiency and the plant’s water balance to optimise irrigation and crop performance under water stress.

introPoints.title: Improving harvest quality
introPoints.text: Contributing to better quality, uniformity, flavour, nutritional value and shelf life of the harvest.

introPoints.title: Reducing unwanted residues
introPoints.text: Our technologies help limit the uptake and accumulation of unwanted residues in plants and soil, including certain heavy metals such as cadmium (Cd) and residues from chemical inputs.

home.introClose: MORECO combines advanced agronomic technologies with field expertise to support growers in meeting the challenges of today’s and tomorrow’s agriculture, with particular attention to plant health, soil, water, nutrient efficiency and the lasting quality of production.

agri.name: Agriculture & crops
agri.blurb: A unique, fully assimilable form of orthosilicic acid: improves phosphorus uptake, supports more efficient water use and contributes to better nutritional quality, higher Brix values, higher yields and a longer shelf life.
intro: Our exclusive range is built on a unique patented stabilized orthosilicic acid (OSA) technology, designed to deliver highly available silicon for plant uptake.
It optimizes phosphorus and water-use efficiency while supporting plant performance, resilience, crop quality, °Brix, yield, and post-harvest shelf life.

rdi.title: Moreco Research & Development
rdi.intro: Since 2009, Moreco has been developing and testing its silicon solutions under real-world conditions, with Moroccan growers and official institutes.
rdi.innovationLead: Innovation in the service of agricultural performance
innovationText: Innovation is at the heart of Moreco’s approach. Since 2009, our company has invested in the research and development of biotechnological solutions for agriculture.

Our R&D department develops and optimises innovative formulations based on advanced technologies, with particular attention to their agronomic efficacy, their uptake by plants and their impact on crop quality.

Our team works closely with growers and research institutes to design, test and improve our solutions under real-world conditions. Every formulation goes through a rigorous process designed to guarantee its quality, its performance and consistent results in use.
rdi.customTitle: Need a custom formulation or product?
customText: Are you looking to develop a specific product, or a formulation suited to your agronomic needs?
Whether it is a solution for your own crops or an innovative product to be marketed and distributed, our R&D team supports you through the design and development of tailor-made solutions.
We study your needs and work with you on formulations suited to your technical and agronomic objectives.

about.contactLead: Our teams answer technical and commercial enquiries.
about.introTitle: Scientific innovation in the service of regenerative agriculture
introText: Moreco develops, selects and optimises advanced agronomic technologies that contribute to regenerative agriculture and to more efficient, sustainable agricultural production.

Our expertise covers in particular plant physiology, stabilised orthosilicic acid (OSA), precision nutrition, soil health, biostimulation, efficient water use and strengthening the physiological resilience of crops.

We select and develop technologies for their scientific relevance, their technological value and their applicability in the field. In this way we offer agricultural professionals solutions designed to optimise the interactions between the soil, the root zone and the plant.

Our approach rests on an integrated vision: a living, healthy soil supports a high-performing root system, a functional plant and, ultimately, quality production that is more efficient and sustainable.
vision: Agriculture founded on innovation, science and sustainability.

workText: At MORECO, we develop innovative solutions for sustainable agriculture, human and animal health, and a healthier environment.
With a hands-on approach, open communication and international ambition, we are building a sustainable future together.
Would you like to contribute to this vision? Explore our career opportunities or send us a speculative application. We look forward to meeting you.

techText: Moreco develops specialised, patented solutions based on OSA (stabilised orthosilicic acid), drawing on advanced technologies developed by our strategic partners for applications in agriculture, human health and animal health.
This OSA technology is the basis of solutions designed to optimise the bioavailability, absorption and physiological action of silicon.
Moreco turns this technology into specialised applications for plants, people and animals, with an approach centred on scientific innovation, technological precision and quality.
